$comment: One standard change model ships, so a routine change has a pre-approved pattern to fit (P03; document 21, B21-9). It counts only once a person approved it: Approved By Decision is a working set field (class W), never in a preset (V44); activation names the accepted configuration change decision that lists or changes the model. Until then no change fits it. Clients add their own models beside it.

rows.label: Routine maintenance in a short window
rows.description: A tested, repeatable change to one application at tier 1 or 2: a connection or certificate renewal, a settings or content update, or an archive run, in a window of four hours or less.
